EventItems.EventItemMinutesNote: Ken Garber, resident, expressed concern about the approval of the new Sustainability Commission bylaws in CA-9. He expressed concern about the lack of opportunity for public comment under the new bylaws.
EventItems.EventItemTitle: Ken Garber - Sustainability Commission bylaws (CA-9) (in person)

EventItems.EventItemMinutesNote: Kathy Griswold, resident, spoke in opposition to CA-3, urging Council to stop hiring consultants.
EventItems.EventItemTitle: Kathy Griswold - North Main Street Transportation Study (CA-3) & Backlog of pedestrian safety improvements (in person)

EventItems.EventItemMinutesNote: Tom Stulberg, resident, spoke about DC-1 and expressed concern regarding the issuance of bonds for the Arbor South project.
EventItems.EventItemTitle: Tom Stulberg - Bond issuance for the Arbor South Project (DC-1) (phone)

EventItems.EventItemMinutesNote: Kitty Kahn, resident, spoke in opposition to DC-1, calling it "Pay for Play."
EventItems.EventItemTitle: Kitty Kahn - Bond issuance for the Arbor South Project (DC-1) (phone)

EventItems.EventItemMinutesNote: Hannah Stanton-Gockel, resident, spoke about bike safety on Stadium Boulevard. She spoke about her program, "Bubbles for Bike Lanes."
EventItems.EventItemTitle: Hannah Stanton-Gockel - Safety on Stadium Blvd (in person)

EventItems.EventItemMinutesNote: Alex Lowe, resident, provided comments regarding the proposed Comprehensive Land Use Plan.
EventItems.EventItemTitle: Alex Lowe - Comprehensive Plan (in person)

EventItems.EventItemMinutesNote: Shannon Lau, Pittsfield Township resident, spoke about the proposed Comprehensive Land Use Plan, stating Ann Arbor has currently become unaffordable.
EventItems.EventItemTitle: Shannon Lau - Comprehensive Plan (in person)

EventItems.EventItemMinutesNote: Patricia Austin, resident, announced a new plaque honoring Ann Arbor's history and the most recent bicentennial celebration. She stated the plaque also clarifies some of the facts regarding the naming of Ann Arbor.
EventItems.EventItemTitle: Patricia Austin - Announcing a new historical plaque (in person)
